text: 据中国汽车工业协会整理的海关总署数据显示，2026年6月，汽车商品进出口总额为318.2亿美元，环比增长8.0%，同比增长35.5%。其中进口金额33.9亿美元，环比下降6.1%，同比下降18.7%；出口金额284.3亿美元，环比增长10.0%，同比增长47.2%。
text_en: According to data from the General Administration of Customs compiled by the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers, in June 2026, the total import and export value of automotive goods was $31.82 billion, up 8.0% month-on-month and 35.5% year-on-year. Among this, imports were $3.39 billion, down 6.1% month-on-month and down 18.7% year-on-year; exports were $28.43 billion, up 10.0% month-on-month and up 47.2% year-on-year.
